summary.en: Diagnostic-ion validation for glycopeptide searches, ambiguity-aware spatial pathways, and scalable mass spectrometry imaging.
summary.zh: 糖肽搜索的诊断离子验证、保留注释歧义的空间通路分析与大规模质谱成像计算。

en: Three studies address complementary computational challenges: reviewing glycopeptide identifications, interpreting ambiguous spatial metabolite assignments, and compressing large imaging datasets without losing regional information.

Coverage spans accessible primary metadata and abstracts across proteomics, small molecules, lipids, ion mobility and imaging. Some publisher pages and feeds were unavailable; this is not an exhaustive survey. All three assessments are abstract-based, and two papers are preprints.
zh: 三项研究分别关注糖肽鉴定的谱图证据审查、保留注释歧义的空间代谢解释，以及兼顾区域信息的大规模成像数据压缩。
本次覆盖蛋白组、小分子、脂质、离子淌度和成像的可访问原始元数据与摘要；部分出版商页面及 feed 不可访问，不能视为穷尽检索。三篇均为摘要阅读，其中两篇为预印本。

papers.title: Benchmarking Glycoproteomics Software Using Diagnostic Ion Based Post-Validation for Glycopeptide Identification

read_scope.en: Original abstract and bibliographic metadata only; no full-text review or reproduction
read_scope.zh: 仅原始摘要与书目元数据；未阅读全文或复现

commentary.en: A comparison of five glycopeptide search tools on BJAB-K20 cell data found that approximately one-third of identifications were unique to individual tools. Post-validation using diagnostic oxonium and Y0/Y1 or b/y ions offers a transferable way to review complementary search results. The study focuses on rare NeuGc/KDN glycans; spectral-evidence tiers are not calibrated error-rate estimates, and broader transferability requires validation. Abstract only.
commentary.zh: 在 BJAB-K20 细胞数据上比较五款糖肽搜索工具，约三分之一的鉴定仅由单个工具给出。作者利用诊断氧鎓离子及 Y0/Y1 或 b/y 离子对搜索结果分层，为互补使用搜索引擎和搜索后审查提供可迁移流程。研究聚焦稀有 NeuGc/KDN 糖型；这种谱图证据分层不能等同于经过校准的错误率估计，跨样本的适用性仍需验证（仅读摘要）。

papers.title: SpacePath enables pathway and molecular-family analysis beyond annotation ambiguity in spatial metabolomics and lipidomics

publication_status.zh: 预印本 v1，未经同行评审

read_scope.en: Original abstract and bibliographic metadata only; no full-text review or reproduction
read_scope.zh: 仅原始摘要与书目元数据；未阅读全文或复现

commentary.en: SpacePath preserves ion-to-compound ambiguity while combining spatial pathway scoring with chemically similar molecular families; four public spatial-lipidomics datasets recovered known patterns, and MS/MS supported four tumor-associated features in new glioblastoma data. Abstract only: the reported increase from about 1% to 24% concerns assignment coverage, not identification accuracy; the useful design is broader spatial interpretation without hiding annotation uncertainty.
commentary.zh: SpacePath保留离子到候选化合物的多重对应，将空间通路评分与化学相似性分子家族结合，在四个公开空间脂质组数据集恢复既有空间模式，并以MS/MS支持新胶质母细胞瘤数据中的四个肿瘤相关特征。仅阅读摘要；从约1%到24%的是分子指派的表征覆盖率而非结构鉴定准确率，其研发价值在于保留注释不确定性、拓展经典通路之外的空间解释。

papers.title: CPMsi: a data-driven Computational Pipeline for fast, large-scale Mass Spectrometry Imaging analysis

publication_status.zh: 预印本 v1，未经同行评审

read_scope.en: Original abstract and bibliographic metadata only; no full-text review or reproduction
read_scope.zh: 仅原始摘要与书目元数据；未阅读全文或复现

commentary.en: CPMsi combines global spectral binning, molecular-region detection and consensus spectra for large MSI datasets and cross-section or multimodal integration; the authors report approximately 30-fold faster region detection than vendor software on brain sections with roughly 500,000–600,000 pixels. Abstract only: this stage-specific benchmark does not establish an end-to-end or clinical-cohort speedup, but the region-preserving compression and cross-section mapping are useful computational designs.
commentary.zh: CPMsi将全局谱图分箱对齐、分子相似区域识别与共识谱压缩串联，用于大规模MSI及连续切片、多模态数据整合；作者在约50万–60万像素的脑切片数据中报告区域识别较厂商软件快约30倍。仅阅读摘要，速度优势限于其测试场景，尚不能推及端到端流程或临床队列；值得借鉴的是保留区域差异的数据压缩与跨切片映射设计。
